newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 31.

text.p: The Washington Post carries the following major business stories on December 31:
WASHINGTON - Tandy Corp., the Texas-based consumer electronics giant, will close all five of its superstores in the Washington-Baltimore area and will begin liquidation sales.
WASHINGTON - Negotiators for Giant Food Inc. and Teamsters Local 639 met face-to-face for the first time, raising hopes of a possible settlement in the 16-day strike.
WASHINGTON - In the bidding war between rail titans CSX Corp. and Norfolk Southern Corp. the prize is Conrail and its dominance in the Northeast.
